Inside the Maison

Featured In
The Maison · Founder
We don't just tell time.We preserve history.Not inside museums. Not behind glass.But on the wrist.Every Jaipur Watch Company creation begins with a story—of a coin, a stamp, a painting, a monument, a craft or a moment that shaped India.Our purpose is simple:To transform India's cultural legacy into objects that can be worn, experienced and passed on.Because when a watch carries meaning, it becomes far more than a watch.It becomes a legacy.

Gaurav Mehta

Founder · Jaipur Watch Company

Handcrafted in Jaipur
